lesson.gone: A lesson no longer in this course

error.correct: That change could not be saved. Refresh the conversation and try again.
error.cancel: The question could not be cancelled. Refresh the conversation and try again.
error.send: Your message could not be confirmed. Your draft is preserved; retry the saved request before sending again.

about: Messages are saved to your course account. A reply appears here only when the companion service returns one. Asking for help never grants course credit.
empty: A question, a connection, a point to revisit. Keep it here as you learn.
deleted.question: You deleted this question.
deleted.answer: Removed with the question you deleted.
cutShort: This reply was cut short when it reached its length limit. Ask a follow-up to hear the rest.
excluded: Not used as context for later answers.
delete.confirm: Delete this question and its answer? Suggestions based on it are revoked. This cannot be undone.
sent.replied: Message saved. A reply has arrived.
sent.waiting: Message saved. Waiting for the companion service to reply.
attachedHelp: Your companion sees this with your message. Select other text in the lesson to change it.
draft.label: Message to your companion
draft.placeholder: What would you like to understand?
noLesson: Open a lesson before sending. You can keep drafting here.
unavailable: This lesson is not currently available for new requests. Your draft is preserved.
consent.title: Keep this check independent?
consent.body: Sending a question will switch every active independent check in this course to practice before help is requested. Those attempts will no longer earn independent credit. A new check may be needed later.
draft.tabOnly: Draft kept in this tab only because browser storage is unavailable.
draft.saved: Draft saved on this device. It is sent only when you choose Send.

error.stop: The reply could not be stopped. Try again, or delete the question.

reply.checking: Written · checking it before it is kept
